items.applicability: Potentially applicable to file-backed A-to-B-to-A on the RTX 4080 and portable host-cache logic. SWA-specific branches apply only if the exact model has SWA layers; backend benefit is not established by CPU/CUDA build success.
items.expected_effect: Could avoid prompt replay and improve reuse latency; correctness must preserve token, tier and MTP-state identity.
items.risk: Stale or mismatched tier/checkpoint lineage can restore invalid KV; host cache may add copy/restore overhead when a useful prefix is absent.
items.falsifiable_test: Run exact file-backed A-to-B-to-A with cache counters and raw prefill timings; require request 3 to restore the same prefix/tier and MTP state, match cold-run output, and show a measured prefill reduction. items.upstream_behavior: Adds request-aware sampled MTP proposals using resolved sampling policy and exact-Q proposal identity, plus adaptive depth/CopySpec integration.
items.current_fork_behavior: The merged native MTP keeps per-sequence proposal state and exact-Q coverage; fork checkpoint/rollback and GPU Turbo4 draft-KV invariants remain in place. The predecessor receipt builds and tests MTP state and adaptive DFlash; this assessment also runs the focused CPU tests.
items.applicability: Native MTP semantics apply to the target on CUDA and portable implementations, but target GPU Turbo4 residency does not itself prove a speed benefit. No CPU MTP/KV or selected_reference change is proposed.
items.expected_effect: May improve proposal validity/acceptance under sampled decoding; can add sampler work and alter acceptance/output behavior, so speed effect is unknown.
items.risk: Sampling seed, exact-Q coverage, proposal-prefix and checkpoint identity errors can alter tokens or invalidate reuse; any CPU synchronization would hurt decode latency.
items.falsifiable_test: Run test-sampling and test-speculative-mtp-state for deterministic policy, exact-Q and rollback cases; then compare request-local proposal/acceptance and latency under the fixed candidate-bound prompts with MTP GPU Turbo4 unchanged.
